notes.title: Hotfix Update 6/3/25
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We've just rolled out a [b]hotfix[/b] addressing several key issues and improving the overall experience. Here’s what’s new:  

[b][h2]📝 Localization & Text Fixes:[/h2][/b]
- Fixed overlapping English and Spanish text—translations are now properly separated.  
- Corrected text printer formatting in specific story passages.  
- Minor spelling and grammar fixes in the Spanish localization.  
- Fixed a reference to [i]Jake’s Paralysis[/i] that appeared incorrectly at the end of the demo.  

[b][h2]🎭 Character & Visual Adjustments:  [/h2][/b]
- Fixed Jake’s character mesh to prevent body parts from overlapping incorrectly.  
- Added a version of Jake [b]without his jacket[/b] for improved scene consistency.  
- Adjusted character scaling and positioning, especially for [b]Nina at the end of the demo[/b].  

[b][h2]🎬 Animation & Timing Improvements:[/h2][/b]
- Fixed Moretto’s [b]disappearance timing[/b] in the bar scene—now he vanishes exactly when he should.  

[b][h2]📸 New Item Illustrations:  [/h2][/b]
- Added [b]key item images[/b] for important story moments: [b]Ice Cream, Ring, Gun, and Powder Case. [/b](More items will be added gradually!)  

We're still hard at work improving the experience, so stay tuned for more updates! Thanks for your support! 💙

notes.title: Poison Noir: Hotfix Update – March 4
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We've just rolled out a [b]hotfix [/b]addressing several visual and text-related issues. Here’s what’s been fixed:

[h2] 🛠 [b]Visual & Animation Fixes:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where Jake’s head was getting cut off during close-ups.
[*] Adjusted the zoom-out behavior so that the text box now disappears after a few seconds.
[*] Smoothed out Jake’s fade-in transition to prevent sudden pop-ins.
[*] Removed the lingering background image behind Jake at the end of a scene.
[*] Corrected a Live2D rendering issue where a piece of Jake’s jacket was appearing on his face.
[*] Fixed inconsistencies with Nina’s jacket—he no longer reappears wearing it after taking it off.
[*] Adjusted character heights and scaling to ensure consistency.
[*] Fixed missing asset transitions so that backgrounds don’t overlap.
[/list]

[h2] 📝[b]Text & Dialogue Fixes:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed inconsistencies in the script.
[*] Corrected incorrect text descriptions (e.g., Nina’s eyes are now properly referenced as green).
[*] Updated the library scene introduction—Jake no longer sees Nina under a tree.
[*] Fixed a dialogue inconsistency where Moretto is mentioned looking at Jake despite disappearing.
[*] Resolved an issue where Moretto would unintentionally reappear in the background after vanishing.
[*] Adjusted the English text printer, fixing formatting issues.
[/list]

[h2] 🎭 [b]Gameplay & Interaction Fixes:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] Locked choice options to prevent rollback after making a decision.
[*] Added missing assets for the gun, powder case, and ring.
[*] Updated Lucy’s visual change during her singing scene.
[*] Implemented camera adjustments in the park scene.
[/list]

This patch also includes general improvements to scene transitions and background rendering. Let us know if you spot anything else! Thanks for your support! 💙
